For each month, calculate the total balance from all users for the previous month (measured as of the 1st of each month), replacing any negative balances with zero. Ensure that data from the first month is used only as a baseline for calculating previous total balance, and exclude it from the final output. Sort the results in ascending order by month.

WITH user_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        txn_type,
        txn_amount,
        CASE 
            WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount
            WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount
            ELSE 0
        END AS balance_change
    FROM customer_transactions
),
user_running_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        SUM(balance_change) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS raw_running_balance
    FROM user_balances
),
user_running_balance_fixed AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        MAX(CASE WHEN raw_running_balance < 0 THEN 0 ELSE raw_running_balance END) AS running_balance
    FROM user_running_balance
    GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date
)
SELECT txn_date, SUM(running_balance) AS total_balance
FROM user_running_balance_fixed
WHERE txn_date IN ('2020-01-01', '2020-02-01', '2020-03-01', '2020-04-01')
GROUP BY txn_date
ORDER BY txn_date

WITH monthly_txn AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        strftime('%Y-%m', CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) as month,
        txn_date,
        CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
             WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount 
             ELSE 0 END as balance_change
    FROM customer_transactions
),
customer_month_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        month,
        SUM(balance_change) as month_balance
    FROM monthly_txn
    GROUP BY customer_id, month
),
cumulative AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        month,
        month_balance,
        SUM(month_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month
                                ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as end_of_month_balance
    FROM customer_month_balance
),
total_by_month AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        SUM(end_of_month_balance) as total_balance
    FROM cumulative
    GROUP BY month
),
with_next AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        total_balance,
        LEAD(month) OVER (ORDER BY month) as next_month
    FROM total_by_month
),
final_output AS (
    SELECT 
        next_month as output_month,
        CASE WHEN total_balance < 0 THEN 0 ELSE total_balance END as total_balance
    FROM with_next
    WHERE next_month IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT * FROM final_output ORDER BY output_month
